lesson_briefs.teacher_goals: Write and solve multi-step word problems using the four operations.

lesson_briefs.title: Which One Doesn’t Belong?
lesson_briefs.purpose: The purpose of this lesson is for students to analyze numbers, expressions, geometric figures, and computations, identify their shared features and unique features, and use their analyses to complete or create Which One Doesn’t Belong sets.
lesson_briefs.teacher_goals:
Analyze numbers, expressions, geometric figures, and computations, and identify their shared and unique features.

Create a Which One Doesn’t Belong set of items with both shared and unique features.
lesson_briefs.student_goal: Let’s complete and create Which One Doesn’t Belong sets.
